08 NOV 2026
Editable design specimens. No connected account. Exact-selection behavior is proposed.

Extend the existing save and Monitor owners
Bind the new destination to the current identity, inventory and navigation contracts. This page is a bounded proposal, not a complete D23 return.
390 · EXACT DESTINATION NOT YET BOUND

Existing save owner
CompanyWatchSave retains the subject, local operation ID, exact list ID and normalized symbol. An accepted response remains pending until a same-owner inventory read started after the response or timeout confirms the membership.

Proposed destination resolver
Reuse /monitor and its current owned inventory. Resolve the captured list ID and symbol under the verified account; use the current list name, then open the list and identify the row. URL naming and focus behavior require implementation proof.

Confirmation is not insertion ownership
The add response and membership readback do not prove which request inserted the row. The current remove owner deletes by list ID and symbol. This study adds no Undo based on that evidence; original recovery references remain separate.

Continue under the same lifecycle
Reuse the existing subject, abort and generation fences. Retire a target on dismissal or account/access invalidation; late reads cannot reopen it. A destination read does not resubmit Save, set the preferred list or run an event check.

paper.guard_qualification: A snapshot is a drift guard, not a document revision, permission or writer lease.

source.scope: Terminal Company save to owned Monitor inventory. Macro WatchStore and the earlier Stocks & Setups fixture do not provide this caller's identity contract.

verification.root_visual_review: All four final 1440x900 native captures inspected, including five 390px and two 320px specimens. Literal newline artifacts and over-technical Chinese wording were corrected and re-read.
verification.advisory_review: Bounded non-author reasoning review found no must-fix; all four JSX exports and two state/context captures were inspected. Its other two image reads were blocked by exec-server transport closure. Root had visually inspected all four captures. Review was not a mandatory delivery gate.
verification.local_environment_boundary: The local file environment disconnected after native completion and byte-hash preparation for eleven artifacts. A pending scratch-only evidence materialization was terminated; no native or GitHub mutation was pending. The canonical package continues on the existing GitHub carrier from retained exact tool data.
verification.scope_limits: Native visual/source checks are not browser, input, screen-reader, full native backup or runtime acceptance.

contracts.confirmation: Accepted response stays pending. The caller starts a tagged same-owner inventory read after the response or timeout. Present membership confirms a postcondition. The operation ID is local coordination, not a server-issued insertion receipt.
contracts.destination: Exact incoming selection, expansion, row identification and focus remain proposed. Generic Open Monitor is explicit until exact selection is bound.
contracts.rename: Match the original ID and show its current name; a reused name is not the original list.
contracts.missing: Distinguish current ready inventory with missing membership, current ready inventory with missing list, failed/restricted/malformed reads, and changed or unknown account.
contracts.unknown_save: The new exact-destination path concerns confirmed membership. Unknown-save recovery stays with the existing save owner; no replay is authorized.
contracts.undo: Current add/readback evidence does not establish insertion ownership; removeSymbols has no operation-owner predicate. No new Undo is enabled on that evidence.
contracts.late_reads: Reuse subject, abort and generation fences; retire the incoming target on dismissal, account/access invalidation or obsolete navigation. Late reads cannot reopen it.
contracts.effects: Proposed destination navigation does not submit Save, set active/default list or run event attention. The inspected owned watchlist persistence path uses SELECT; authentication and full runtime no-effect behavior are not claimed.

remaining_proof: Exact destination binding and consumer wiring; URL/transport contract not invented here.
Fresh owned reads, current-account access, late-response suppression and no replay in the real consumer.
Keyboard/touch, visible focus, screen-reader announcements and responsive behavior.
No account endpoint, membership mutation, alert, position, trade or runtime navigation was executed.
GET payload does not itself witness subjectId/operationId; client binding needs consumer proof.
Visible JSX equality does not establish hidden properties, comments or full native backup/restore.
No RIG acceptance, complete D23 return, foundation release, writer lease, deployment or held PR control change.
